summary: Added 'Repos' column to recent completed tasks widget. Updated get_recent_completed() in queries.py to JOIN task_commits and aggregate repo_slug, branch, commit_sha via GROUP_CONCAT, with Python post-processing to build repo_commits list and push_target field. Updated recent_completed.html template to show per-repo badge (green 'main' / yellow 'branch') and GitHub commit link. Added 4 new tests (2 query, 2 template) and updated existing fixtures/column sets.
